learning_objective: 🎯 You will discover how to identify naming words and sort them into special groups like Proper, Common, Collective, and Abstract nouns!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A noun is simply a naming word! It is the name of any person, place, animal, thing, or even an idea. Everything around you has a name, and that name is a noun.
Common nouns name general things like 'city' or 'boy'. Proper nouns name specific things like 'Delhi' or 'Rahul'. Remember, Proper nouns always begin with a Capital Letter!
When we want to talk about a group or collection of people, animals, or things as one whole unit, we use collective nouns. Examples include a 'flock' of birds or a 'team' of players.
These are invisible nouns! Abstract nouns name qualities, feelings, or ideas that you cannot touch or see, like 'happiness', 'bravery', or 'honesty'.

fun_activity.title: ✍️ The Noun Hunt Window Game
fun_activity.instructions: Look outside your window right now and list 3 Common nouns you see, think of 1 Proper noun nearby, and write down 1 Abstract noun about how you feel today!

quick_recap: ⭐ Nouns are naming words for people, places, animals, things, and ideas.
⭐ Proper nouns give specific names and always start with capital letters.
⭐ Collective nouns describe groups, and Abstract nouns describe feelings or qualities.
